Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 11: the slip of [[Lady Valarian (Errata)|•Lady Valarian]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014), marked “E”. It prints errata version PC-E1 (“… (except Hutt Bounty and Jabba's Prize) may be treated as "Lady Valarian." Once per turn, may target a Mistryl of ability > 2 here; target is Heroic until end of turn.”).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
